prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1115; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving on a main road in League City, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me because of a light that had just turned yellow.

Q: What happened next?

A: I eased off the gas and started to brake. The car behind me didn't slow down in time, and it hit the back of my vehicle pretty hard.

Q: Was anyone else involved?

A: No, just the two cars. The other driver got out and came over to check on me. We exchanged information and called the police.

Q: Did you go to the hospital or see a doctor after the accident?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening. They said I had whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some medication.

Q: What symptoms are you still experiencing?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to check my blind spot. I also get headaches a few times a week, and I've had trouble sleeping because of the pain.

Q: Have you missed any work or other activities because of your injuries?

A: I missed about three days of work in the first week. Since then I've been going to physical therapy twice a week, and I've had to limit lifting and driving for longer trips.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been trying to follow the treatment plan my doctor gave me, and I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.

A: Thank you.
